title: Recently Done
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：recently　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recently 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Recently, in 1964 the guide returned the map at the ledge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: before the July rains the guide had ② recently returned the map, and nobody had asked a single question. The guide had come to the valley two days earlier, and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The guidebook for July 1958 puts it plainer. The map was ③ recently popular, and the traveller who kept it had ④ recently found it twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done recently in those days. The traveller wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else. He returned the map ⑤ more recently than anybody else in the valley, and of all who returned it that day he returned it ⑥ the most recently of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was that the map be found ⑦ recently every day, and that whoever did it be ⑧ recently careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done recently.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974 she returned the map ⑨ recently with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Recently, she said in 1976, that was the part the valley never forgot; the guidebook still speaks recently of it. She kept the map in the same ledge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot how recently it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 最近（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had recently returned …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 最近（修饰形容词：recently popular）
C. adv. 近来（评注性状语，置于句首：Recently, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 近来（修饰过去分词：had recently found it）
E. adv. 最近（比较级 more recently than：拿叔叔跟山谷里其他人相比）
F. adv. 最近（最高级 the most recently of all of them：那个日子所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 近来（被动结构中的中位状语：be found recently）
H. adv. 近来（修饰形容词：be recently careful about the whole business）

answers.why: recently 意为“最近”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Recently, in 1964 …。
recently 意为“最近”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had recently returned the map。
recently 意为“最近”，此处修饰形容词 popular（受欢迎）：was recently popular。
recently 意为“近来”，此处修饰过去分词 found：had recently found it twice。
recently 意为“最近”，拿叔叔跟山谷里所有人相比，故用比较级 more recently than。
recently 意为“最近”，那个日子里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the most recently of all of them。
recently 意为“近来”，被动结构 be found recently 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
recently 意为“近来”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be recently careful about the whole business。
recently 意为“最近”，1974 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次返回那件小小的地图，副词置于动词之后。
recently 意为“近来”，母亲 1976 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Recently, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，向导近来在崖台返回那件小小的地图；山谷里人人都说那是头一回。（Recently, …）
雨季到来之前，向导已经最近返回那件小小的地图。（had recently returned …）
那件小小的地图当时最近受欢迎。（recently popular）
保管它的那位旅人在入冬前已经近来把它找过两回。（had recently found it）
叔叔做这件事比山谷里任何人都来得最近。（more recently than …）
在那个日子里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最最近。（the most recently of all of them）
answers: Recently, in 1964 the guide returned the map at the ledge.
Before the July rains the guide had recently returned the map.
The traveller who kept it had recently found it twice before the winter came.
He returned the map more recently than anybody else in the valley.
Of all who did it that day, he did it the most recently of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 recently 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Recently, in 1964 the guide returned the map, and nobody forgot it.
Before the July rains the guide had recently returned the map.
The map was recently popular, or so the guidebook says.
The traveller had recently found it twice before the winter came.
My mother returned the map recently with great care when nobody else would.
Recently, the valley never forgot that part of the story.
